goal: Ship the gated Gallery Page — a zero-JS photo grid fed by a build-time responsive-image pipeline, a native-feeling lightbox island, and a curated launch content pass — and prototype the invitation-derived layered background-pattern treatment on Home for the Team Lead's design ruling.

in_progress.title: Image build pipeline: gallery masters become responsive variants and a manifest
in_progress.summary: A prebuild script derives per-photo AVIF+WebP width ladders (capped at the master's intrinsic width, never upscaling), a blur placeholder, and intrinsic dimensions into a generated-variant manifest; content-hashed to skip unchanged masters; HEIC masters one-time converted to committed JPEG. Per ADR 019f3fba-e3d6: build-time processing, static serving, no runtime image service.

in_progress.title: Pattern assets derived: muted duotone wall tile and full-color accents
in_progress.summary: From the supplied seamless invitation tile, derive a muted forest/sage duotone wall tile at near-watermark contrast against cream (recolored toward Theme tokens) plus web-optimized full-color motif accents (fig, foliage, Golden Gate) for text-free zones; blend any visible seam; preserve the source tile under source material.

not_shipped.title: Gallery Page walks: gated route, nav entry, zero-JS photo grid
not_shipped.summary: A new gated Gallery route renders a server-side justified-rows grid (two columns on mobile) from a section-capable photo manifest, shipping zero client JS, reserving each tile's aspect ratio (zero CLS), lazy-loading below-the-fold, with an edge gutter; nav gains Gallery between Travel and Registry; ships an initial demoable subset.

not_shipped.title: Lightbox island: full-screen photo viewing with native-feeling gestures
not_shipped.summary: A dynamically-imported lightbox opens on first photo tap with swipe/pinch/tap gestures and visible arrow fallback, a hand-written single-history-entry back-button contract that restores grid scroll, and full a11y (focus trap/return, Escape, arrow keys, reduced-motion); styled exclusively via Theme tokens over the library's CSS variables.

not_shipped.title: Launch content pass: curated photo set, order, alt text, and captions
not_shipped.summary: With the Team Lead, confirm the shipped photo selection and order; content-steward writes alt text for every photo and captions where they add context, in the site's tone, carried by the photo manifest; no unconfirmed facts in captions. HITL slice — content-fidelity gate on the shipped words.

not_shipped.title: Home prototype of the layered pattern treatment, ending in the Team Lead's ruling
not_shipped.summary: On a preview deployment, Home only renders the layered treatment: the muted duotone tile as the page wall with content on solid cream panels echoing the invitation arch, plus full-color accents in text-free zones; no body text over the pattern, contrast measured against the cream panel, reduced-motion static. The Team Lead rules (layered/wall-only/accents-only/drop); the ruling is recorded and updates the site-wide rollout issue.
